SEARCH
Package model.users

Class GraduateStudent

java.lang.Object
model.users.User
model.users.Student
model.users.GraduateStudent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Student>, Researcher, Observer
public class GraduateStudent extends Student implements Researcher, Serializable
Represents a graduate (Master or PhD) student. Extends Student and also implements the Researcher interface, because graduate students can publish papers and have an H-Index. A graduate student must have a supervisor (Researcher) with H-Index >= 3.
